method.page_set: fixtures/real-world/*/input.html as they are, and bench/pages/gen-pages.mjs's long documents
method.quality: each system's cold PDF of a real-world page against its committed Chrome reference (fixtures/tools/compare.mjs, the pass rule of fixtures/README.md)
method.fontconfig: fixtures/fonts only; text unhinted and in grayscale, as when the Chrome references were rendered

grover.label: Grover (Chrome)
grover.about: Grover 1.2.10, Puppeteer, Chrome; the page's own scripts run in Chrome, which prints once they are done by the Chrome references' rule (two animation frames and a task after load). Warm: Ruby process and Chrome reused (browser_ws_endpoint); the Node process that only keeps Chrome open is left out of the memory sum (reported separately).

excluded.what: the Node process that only keeps Chrome open (bench/grover/browser.cjs); its Chrome is counted

surimono-ruby.label: surimono + fulgur (Ruby)
surimono-ruby.about: Surimono::Renderer#render_page (the page's own scripts in QuickJS on the virtual clock, printer-safe output on, the page's <script src> and <link href> files given as resources:), then the fulgur gem 0.40.0 prints the HTML, in one Ruby process.

surimono-raikiri.label: surimono + Raikiri (indicative)
surimono-raikiri.about: As surimono + fulgur (Ruby), but fulgur's Raikiri backend (fulgur-raikiri 0.41.0 through fixtures/tools/raikiri-print, the printer matrix's driver) prints the HTML in a process of its own, started by the Ruby process for every document: Raikiri has no Ruby binding, so its warm row reuses the renderer but never a warm printer. Indicative: not the setup a user of a gem would run.

grover-shell.label: Grover (chrome-headless-shell)
grover-shell.about: As Grover (Chrome), on chrome-headless-shell of the same build (Puppeteer's headless: "shell"), the leanest Chrome a Grover user can run.

excluded.what: the Node process that only keeps Chrome open (bench/grover/browser.cjs); its Chrome is counted
